title: Phones With the Best Cameras (2026)
summary: The Galaxy S26 Ultra is the best camera phone sold in the US, the iPhone 18 Pro leads for video and the Pixel 11 Pro for point-and-shoot.
method: Picks come from Tom's Guide, TechRadar, PhoneArena, Fstoppers, TalkAndroid, BGR and DeinHandy. Only phones named by at least two of these sources are listed.
assumptions: We show no prices because phone prices change often. Some roundups were written before the iPhone 18 Pro and Pixel 11 launched, so check recent reviews too.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra
products.badge: Best camera phone sold in the US
why: Tom's Guide gives the Galaxy S26 Ultra its best camera phone award, and TalkAndroid names it the best camera phone in the US. PhoneArena calls it the best phone for still photography in its benchmark.
PhoneArena lists a 200MP main camera, a 50MP 5x periscope, a 10MP 3x telephoto and a 50MP ultrawide.
cons: Photos can look more processed than the iPhone's
products.best_for: Anyone who wants the most flexible camera phone in a US store
products.skip_if: You mainly want the best video or the simplest point-and-shoot
products.amazon_listing: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, Unlocked Android Smartphone, 256GB, Black | Privacy Display, Gal

products.name: Apple iPhone 18 Pro / 18 Pro Max
why: Tom's Guide highlights the new variable-aperture main camera on the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. DeinHandy lists a triple camera with 8x optical zoom and strong Dolby Vision video.
Before the 18 Pro launched, TechRadar and Fstoppers named the iPhone 17 Pro Max the best camera phone overall, praising its video system with ProRes RAW and Apple Log 2.
pros: Variable aperture adds real depth control
products.skip_if: You want the widest zoom range or an Android phone

products.name: Google Pixel 11 Pro / Pro XL
why: TalkAndroid names the Pixel 11 Pro the best point-and-shoot, with a 48MP telephoto that Google says captures 30% more light and a faster Night Sight. BGR calls the Pro XL's main camera possibly the best it has used on any Android phone.
TalkAndroid warns the smaller Pro has a 4,850mAh battery, so heavy shooting days may need a top-up.
cons: Weaker overall performance than rival flagships
One telephoto lens versus Samsung's two
products.best_for: People who want great photos without fiddling
products.skip_if: You want the most zoom flexibility or the best video
products.amazon_listing: Google Pixel 11 Pro XL - Unlocked Smartphone, Gemini - 256 GB - Olive | Android, Gemini In

products.name: Vivo X300 Ultra / Oppo Find X9 Ultra
products.badge: Best image quality (not sold in US)
why: Fstoppers says the most capable camera phones come from vivo, Xiaomi and OPPO, and none is officially sold in the US. TalkAndroid names the Vivo X300 Ultra best for overall image quality and the Oppo Find X9 Ultra best for zoom, and says both out-shoot the Galaxy S26 Ultra.
PhoneArena also ranks Oppo's Ultra camera among the top of its benchmark.
specs: Not officially sold in the US
cons: Not officially sold in the US
Imports may lack warranty and support
products.best_for: Enthusiasts outside the US who want the best possible camera
products.skip_if: You live in the US and want a supported phone
